approval.what: A gated call waits for an authenticated person's approval of its exact arguments.

delivery_binding.what: Recipients come from Relay's directory by user ID; a foreign link is refused.

egress.what: Content hosts are decrypted at the proxy and only Relay's repository is allowed.

egress_domain_only.what: The 4.21.0 to 4.25.0 domain allowlist: names only, no paths.

judge_isolation.what: Judged output is placed in a data envelope and grader directives in it are neutralized, so the text under review cannot set its own verdict.

marking.what: Spotlighting envelope with a secret nonce; hidden characters removed; imitation markers neutralized. Lowers how often a model obeys; cannot be shown to stop an effect.

memory_review.what: A proposed fact is never recalled until a person accepts it.

memory_trust.what: An untrusted fact holding an address, a link or an instruction to act is refused.

output_marking.what: parse_summary drops a summary that holds an address, markup or hidden text.

recall_taint.what: Recall goes through RECALL_MEMORY, whose result is untrusted, so a run that recalls memory cannot take an external effect no person approved.

render.what: Untrusted text becomes HTML with no image and no clickable address outside Relay.

tool_scope.what: After a run reads untrusted text, an external effect without an approval rule is refused (tainted_external) and audited.
